name: 检验线 HIS 申请↔LIS 结果月对账

sides.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM') AS K, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER WHERE REQUESTED_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(:START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND REQUESTED_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE(:END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM')
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(7), sampledate, 120) AS K, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM dbo.lab_report WHERE sampledate >= :START_DATE AND sampledate < :END_DATE GROUP BY CONVERT(varchar(7), sampledate, 120)

object_desc_tpl: LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER 与 LIS.lab_report 月度数量对账
large_table_guard: LAB_RESULT 必须按申请键+月窗子查询限定，禁全表 GROUP BY
